svg.text: ICEYfish
Goldfish your Magic: The Gathering deck.
Free, in your browser. No sign-up.
skyweezydeezy.github.io/ICEYfish
Scan, paste your list, and see how it really runs.
Build
Paste a decklist: curve, tags and strengths
Mulligan
Opening hands with London mulligans and land odds
Practice
Play it by hand against a goldfish, with autopilot and undo
Simulate
2,000 autopiloted games: mana by turn and kill turn
Odds
The exact chance to draw the cards you need, turn by turn
Duel
One computer opponent, or Play a friend (beta)
Pod
A four-player Commander pod against the computer
